UNIT.g011-vlad2_desc:
* Guardian Introduction: 
Vladmir *

Count Vlad has lived in his mansion for hundreds of years

He is from a well-known noble family, but he has been living alone since his family left. People say that he turns red because he easily gets shy

When he makes eye contact, laser beams come out of his eyes

So he started wearing sun glasses when Blue Bell moved in with him

UNIT.g012-bluebell2_desc:
* Guardian Introduction: Blue Bell *\n
A child ghost who loves playing pranks.\n
She struck up a friendship with a pumpkin she met at Halloween\n
She takes her rabbit doll, a gift she received as a child, with her wherever she goes\n
She may look cute But when she gets angry, she casts a magic spell on the rabbit doll to make it attack people\n
Her favorite hobby is to surprise the shy Vladmir with her antics
